faqs.question: How do I know if I have carpenter ants versus regular ants in my Forest Hills home?
faqs.answer: Carpenter ants are larger than common ants (typically ¼ to ½ inch long) and are usually black or dark brown. Signs include piles of wood shavings (frass) near wooden structures, rustling sounds in walls, and winged ants appearing indoors in spring. Our technicians can help identify the species during a free phone consultation.
